description: Creates, deletes, or updates CloudTrail configuration. Ensures logging is also enabled.

parameters.name: access_key
parameters.description: AWS access key ID. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID or AWS_ACCESS_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The aws_access_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_access_key_id alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: aws_ca_bundle
parameters.description: The location of a CA Bundle to use when validating SSL certificates. The AWS_CA_BUNDLE environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: aws_config
parameters.description: A dictionary to modify the botocore configuration. Parameters can be found in the AWS documentation https://botocore.amazonaws.com/v1/documentation/api/latest/reference/config.html#botocore.config.Config.

parameters.name: cloudwatch_logs_log_group_arn
parameters.description: A full ARN specifying a valid CloudWatch log group to which CloudTrail logs will be delivered. The log group should already exist. See https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/send-cloudtrail-events-to-cloudwatch-logs.html. Required when cloudwatch_logs_role_arn.

parameters.name: cloudwatch_logs_role_arn
parameters.description: Specifies a full ARN for an IAM role that assigns the proper permissions for CloudTrail to create and write to the log group. See https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/send-cloudtrail-events-to-cloudwatch-logs.html. Required when cloudwatch_logs_log_group_arn.

parameters.name: debug_botocore_endpoint_logs
parameters.description: Use a botocore.endpoint logger to parse the unique (rather than total) "resource:action" API calls made during a task, outputing the set to the resource_actions key in the task results. Use the aws_resource_action callback to output to total list made during a playbook. The ANSIBLE_DEBUG_BOTOCORE_LOGS environment variable may also be used. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: enable_log_file_validation
parameters.description: Specifies whether log file integrity validation is enabled. CloudTrail will create a hash for every log file delivered and produce a signed digest file that can be used to ensure log files have not been tampered. Choices: false true

parameters.name: enable_logging
parameters.description: Start or stop the CloudTrail logging. If stopped the trail will be paused and will not record events or deliver log files. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: endpoint_url
parameters.description: URL to connect to instead of the default AWS endpoints. While this can be used to connection to other AWS-compatible services the amazon.aws and community.aws collections are only tested against AWS. The AWS_URL environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: include_global_events
parameters.description: Record API calls from global services such as IAM and STS. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: is_multi_region_trail
parameters.description: Specify whether the trail belongs only to one region or exists in all regions. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: kms_key_id
parameters.description: Specifies the KMS key ID to use to encrypt the logs delivered by CloudTrail. This also has the effect of enabling log file encryption. The value can be an alias name prefixed by “alias/”, a fully specified ARN to an alias, a fully specified ARN to a key, or a globally unique identifier. Encryption can be disabled by setting kms_key_id="". See https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/encrypting-cloudtrail-log-files-with-aws-kms.html.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name for the CloudTrail. Names are unique per-region unless the CloudTrail is a multi-region trail, in which case it is unique per-account. Default: "default"

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: A named AWS profile to use for authentication. See the AWS documentation for more information about named profiles https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-configure-profiles.html. The AWS_PROFILE environment variable may also be used. The profile option is mutually exclusive with the aws_access_key, aws_secret_key and session_token options.

parameters.name: purge_tags
parameters.description: If purge_tags=true and tags is set, existing tags will be purged from the resource to match exactly what is defined by tags parameter. If the tags parameter is not set then tags will not be modified, even if purge_tags=True. Tag keys beginning with aws: are reserved by Amazon and can not be modified. As such they will be ignored for the purposes of the purge_tags parameter. See the Amazon documentation for more information https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws_tagging.html#tag-conventions. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The AWS region to use. For global services such as IAM, Route53 and CloudFront, region is ignored. The AWS_REGION environment variable may also be used. See the Amazon AWS documentation for more information http://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#ec2_region.

parameters.name: s3_bucket_name
parameters.description: An existing S3 bucket where CloudTrail will deliver log files. This bucket should exist and have the proper policy. See https://docs.aws.amazon.com/awscloudtrail/latest/userguide/aggregating_logs_regions_bucket_policy.html. Required when state=present.

parameters.name: s3_key_prefix
parameters.description: S3 Key prefix for delivered log files. A trailing slash is not necessary and will be removed.

parameters.name: secret_key
parameters.description: AWS secret access key. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY or AWS_SECRET_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The secret_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_secret_access_key alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: session_token
parameters.description: AWS STS session token for use with temporary credentials. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SESSION_TOKEN environment variable may also be used. The session_token and profile options are mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: sns_topic_name
parameters.description: SNS Topic name to send notifications to when a log file is delivered.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Add or remove CloudTrail configuration. The following states have been preserved for backwards compatibility: state=enabled and state=disabled. state=enabled is equivalet to state=present. state=disabled is equivalet to state=absent. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent" "enabled" "disabled"

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: A dictionary representing the tags to be applied to the resource. If the tags parameter is not set then tags will not be modified.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: When set to false, SSL certificates will not be validated for communication with the AWS APIs. Setting validate_certs=false is strongly discouraged, as an alternative, consider setting aws_ca_bundle instead. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: create single region cloudtrail
  amazon.aws.cloudtrail:
    state: present
    name: default
    s3_bucket_name: mylogbucket
    s3_key_prefix: cloudtrail
    region: us-east-1

- name: create multi-region trail with validation and tags
  amazon.aws.cloudtrail:
    state: present
    name: default
    s3_bucket_name: mylogbucket
    region: us-east-1
    is_multi_region_trail: true
    enable_log_file_validation: true
    cloudwatch_logs_role_arn: "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/CloudTrail_CloudWatchLogs_Role"
    cloudwatch_logs_log_group_arn: "arn:aws:logs:us-east-1:123456789012:log-group:CloudTrail/DefaultLogGroup:*"
    kms_key_id: "alias/MyAliasName"
    tags:
      environment: dev
      Name: default

- name: show another valid kms_key_id
  amazon.aws.cloudtrail:
    state: present
    name: default
    s3_bucket_name: mylogbucket
    kms_key_id: "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012"
    # simply "12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012" would be valid too.

- name: pause logging the trail we just created
  amazon.aws.cloudtrail:
    state: present
    name: default
    enable_logging: false
    s3_bucket_name: mylogbucket
    region: us-east-1
    is_multi_region_trail: true
    enable_log_file_validation: true
    tags:
      environment: dev
      Name: default

- name: delete a trail
  amazon.aws.cloudtrail:
    state: absent
    name: default

return_values.name: exists
return_values.description: whether the resource exists. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: trail
return_values.description: CloudTrail resource details. Returned: always Sample: "hash/dictionary of values"

return_values.name: cloud_watch_logs_log_group_arn
return_values.description: Full ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group where events are delivered. Returned: success when present Sample: "arn:aws:logs:us-east-1:123456789012:log-group:CloudTrail/DefaultLogGroup:*"

return_values.name: cloud_watch_logs_role_arn
return_values.description: Full ARN of the IAM role that CloudTrail assumes to deliver events. Returned: success when present Sample: "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/CloudTrail_CloudWatchLogs_Role"

return_values.name: has_custom_event_selectors
return_values.description: Whether any custom event selectors are used for this trail. Returned: success Sample: false

return_values.name: has_insight_selectors
return_values.description: Whether any insight selectors are used for this trail. Returned: success Sample: false

return_values.name: home_region
return_values.description: The home region where the trail was originally created and must be edited. Returned: success Sample: "us-east-1"

return_values.name: include_global_service_events
return_values.description: Whether global services (IAM, STS) are logged with this trail. Returned: success Sample: true

return_values.name: is_logging
return_values.description: Whether logging is turned on or paused for the Trail. Returned: success Sample: true

return_values.name: is_multi_region_trail
return_values.description: Whether the trail applies to all regions or just one. Returned: success Sample: true

return_values.name: is_organization_trail
return_values.description: Specifies whether the trail is created for all accounts in an organization in Organizations, or only for the current Amazon Web Services account. Returned: success Sample: true

return_values.name: kms_key_id
return_values.description: Full ARN of the KMS Key used to encrypt log files. Returned: success when present Sample: "arn:aws:kms::123456789012:key/12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012"

return_values.name: log_file_validation_enabled
return_values.description: Whether log file validation is enabled on the trail. Returned: success Sample: true

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Name of the CloudTrail resource. Returned: success Sample: "default"

return_values.name: s3_bucket_name
return_values.description: S3 bucket name where log files are delivered. Returned: success Sample: "myBucket"

return_values.name: s3_key_prefix
return_values.description: Key prefix in bucket where log files are delivered (if any). Returned: success when present Sample: "myKeyPrefix"

return_values.name: sns_topic_arn
return_values.description: Full ARN of the SNS topic where log delivery notifications are sent. Returned: success when present Sample: "arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:topic/myTopic"

return_values.name: sns_topic_name
return_values.description: The SNS topic name where log delivery notifications are sent. Returned: success when present Sample: "myTopic"

return_values.name: tags
return_values.description: hash/dictionary of tags applied to this resource Returned: success Sample: {"Name": "default", "environment": "dev"}

return_values.name: trail_arn
return_values.description: Full ARN of the CloudTrail resource. Returned: success Sample: "arn:aws:cloudtrail:us-east-1:123456789012:trail/default"
